draft_reason: non-organ implementation surfaces are visible before their Git membrane is closed and need explicit ownership.
promotion_condition: all listed implementation surfaces are tracked, quarantined, or migrated behind bounded organ/service contracts; no unplanned implementation source remains visible.
purpose: Classify non-organ implementation surfaces whose source/projection files may be visible before their Git membrane is closed.

active_partial.rule: An active partial implementation surface is real source but has an open Git membrane or incomplete topology closure.
active_partial.exit_condition: track or quarantine all visible files and promote to canonical runtime/source classification

adapter_partial.rule: An adapter partial is a cortex/runtime adapter projection whose source of truth must stay outside ad hoc local edits.
adapter_partial.exit_condition: generate from exposure/registry contracts, absorb into canonical adapter config, or quarantine

projection_partial.rule: A projection partial is generated or deployment-facing material whose upstream authority must be explicit.
projection_partial.exit_condition: make generation reproducible and validated, or track/quarantine the projection explicitly

quarantined.rule: A quarantined implementation surface is not active source truth.
quarantined.exit_condition: delete, migrate into a bounded organ/service, or reclassify after validation

transitional.rule: A transitional implementation surface has known boundary debt and must not expand in place.
transitional.exit_condition: resolve next_action through migration, promotion, quarantine, or deletion

surfaces.next_action: decide whether .agents remains an adapter projection or is absorbed by AGENTS.md plus cortex adapter config
keep MCP wrappers generated from exposure/registry contracts or migrate them behind organ-exposure
track or quarantine local mobile tests before treating app behavior as closed
track or quarantine local REST/storage source files before declaring the kernel source membrane closed
track or quarantine local mesh/domain source files before declaring the node runtime membrane closed
render deployment units from registry/organ manifests or track the projection files explicitly
